annotations.title: Get one episode's notes and sources

description: Returns one episode's show notes: summary, takeaways, the check the episode suggests running, chapters with timestamps, topics, every primary source it cites (title and URL), and links to the page, the MP3 and the YouTube video when there is one. Use this when you have an episode id and need its findings and sources without the full transcript. The show's hosts are AI-generated voices.

id.description: Episode id as returned by search_episodes or list_episodes, for example 2026-11-20-nginx-five-teams-daily.

name: get_episode
